exercises.name: Around The World

source_english.description: Around The World traces a controlled circle with the dumbbells around the body while the torso stays steady.
instructions: Stand tall holding the dumbbells with your arms extended as appropriate for the movement.
Sweep the weight(s) in a smooth circle around the body without twisting the torso.

instructions: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted. Grip the barbell and hold it over the chest.

instructions: Set up on your bodyweight with a soft bend in the elbows and the chest supported as required.
Open the arms only as far as the shoulders remain comfortable.
Bring the hands together by squeezing the chest without changing the elbow angle.
Return slowly to the starting position.
form_cues: Move through the chest, not the wrists.
common_mistakes: Turning the movement into a press.
source_english.safety_note: Use a light load and stop before the shoulder reaches an uncomfortable stretch.

exercises.name: Crunch (Weighted)

source_english.description: Crunch (Weighted) curls the ribs toward the pelvis from a supine bent-knee position.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Brace and curl the ribs toward the pelvis.
Pause without pulling the neck.
Lower the torso slowly to the support.
source_english.safety_note: Use a comfortable curl range and reduce the decline or load before the neck or back loses control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press

source_english.description: Dumbbell Squeeze Press is a supported chest press using one dumbbell in each hand.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted. Grip one dumbbell in each hand and hold it over the chest.
Lower the resistance toward the chest with elbows controlled.
Pause without bouncing or losing shoulder position.
Press back to straight arms, then rerack or set the weights down safely.
source_english.safety_note: Use a spotter or safeties for the loaded press and stop before shoulder control is lost.

evidence.value: Жим-стискання гантелей — це жим грудей із опорою на лаву, під час якого по одній гантелі утримують у кожній руці та притискають їх одна до одної.
Ляжте на рівну лаву, поставте стопи на підлогу, візьміть по гантелі в кожну руку та притисніть їх одна до одної над грудьми.
Контрольовано опустіть гантелі до грудей, продовжуючи стискати їх і керуючи ліктями.
Виштовхніть гантелі до випрямлення рук, зберігаючи тиск між ними, потім безпечно покладіть їх.
